description: This file defines the MAX_Dal_Inventory_Trackers class, which manages database operations related to ad trackers, including retrieving, setting, and verifying tracker append codes within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Inventory_Trackers
classes.description: A data access layer class for managing ad tracker append codes and related operations in the database.

methods.name: getAppendCodes
methods.description: Retrieves append codes for a specific tracker ID from the database.

methods.name: setAppendCodes
methods.description: Sets or updates append codes for a specific tracker ID, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: generateAppendCode
methods.description: Generates a combined append code string from an array of code entries, applying specific transformations for auto-tracking.

methods.name: checkCompiledAppendCodes
methods.description: Checks and verifies the consistency of compiled append codes against database entries.

methods.name: recompileAppendCodes
methods.description: Recomputes and updates append codes for given tracker IDs or all trackers if no IDs are provided.
